row.problem_statement:
# Missing UI import in experiments remove command

## Description

I'm trying to use the `dvc experiments remove` command and I'm getting a strange error. When I try to remove experiments, I get a `ModuleNotFoundError` error.

I traced the issue to the `dvc/commands/experiments/remove.py` file. It seems that the `ui` module is imported but then not used anywhere in the code. However, when I try to remove the import, all the experiment removal functionality breaks.

## Steps to reproduce

1. Create a DVC project with some experiments
2. Try to remove experiments with:
```
dvc exp remove exp-12345
```

## Error traceback

```
Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "/usr/local/bin/dvc", line 8, in <module>
    sys.exit(main())
  File "/usr/local/lib/python3.8/site-packages/dvc/cli/main.py", line 32, in main
    return cli.run()
  File "/usr/local/lib/python3.8/site-packages/dvc/cli/cli.py", line 42, in run
    return self.parse_args(argv)
  File "/usr/local/lib/python3.8/site-packages/dvc/cli/cli.py", line 76, in parse_args
    return args.func(args)
  File "/usr/local/lib/python3.8/site-packages/dvc/commands/experiments/remove.py", line 45, in run
    return self.repo.experiments.remove(
  File "/usr/local/lib/python3.8/site-packages/dvc/repo/experiments/remove.py", line 50, in remove
    _resolve_exp_by_name(repo, exp_names, commit_ref_set, queued_ref_set, git_remote)
  File "/usr/local/lib/python3.8/site-packages/dvc/repo/experiments/remove.py", line 93, in _resolve_exp_by_name
    result = repo.experiments.get_ref_and_entry_by_names(exp_name, git_remote)
AttributeError: 'Experiments' object has no attribute 'get_ref_and_entry_by_names'
```

I also noticed that the `keep` parameter is defined in the function signature but there's no code that handles it in the implementation.

This issue appeared after updating to the latest version of DVC.
